* A large [[USAF|air force]] [[C-5 Galaxy]] military cargo jet crashed when landing at [[Dover Air Force Base]] in the [[U.S. state]] of [[Delaware]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2006/US/04/03/c5.crash/index.html (CNN)]
* Judge [[Anand Satyanand]] has been appointed to succeed Dame [[Silvia Cartwright]] as [[Governor-General of New Zealand]]. He will take up office on August 4, 2006. [https://web.archive.org/web/20070311011203/http://www.beehive.govt.nz/ViewDocument.aspx?DocumentID=25354 (Beehive)]
